Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in Step 3 by incorrectly stating that the Battle of Guam occurred in 1945. The WebSurfer had previously confirmed in Step 1 that the Battle of Guam took place from July 21 to August 10, 1944. Despite having this correct data, the Planner reversed the year in its "Updated Understanding" section, claiming "Guam: July 21 - August 10, 1945." This hallucination of the year led to a flawed chronological comparison logic (comparing months within the same year) rather than correctly identifying the year difference (1944 vs 1945), which was the primary basis for determining which battle occurred first.
